evals.expected_output: Asks which page or change to review before offering any options, and does not start a review.
expectations: Asks for the file, diff, or PR to look at
Does not run any review skill or produce findings
Does not present the spot-check versus full-review pick list before a target exists

evals.prompt: Can you review docs/python/how-to-guides/use-select-view-update.md? I rewrote most of it.
evals.expected_output: Recommends a full review because the page was substantially rewritten, offers the spot-check and one-dimension alternatives with their costs, and waits for a choice.
expectations: Leads with a recommendation of the full review (accuracy, structure, style) and says why
Offers quick spot check and a single-dimension review as alternatives, with a plain-words cost for each
Asks a single question and waits; does not start reviewing before the person chooses

evals.prompt: Can you check my docs? I only changed one sentence about the default heap size in docs/python/how-to-guides/configuration/config-file.md.
evals.expected_output: Loads the router, recognizes a one-sentence change, recommends the spot check with the full review as the alternative, and waits for the person's choice before running either.
expectations: Invokes deephaven-docs-help rather than going straight to a review skill, since the person did not name a review depth
Leads with a recommendation of the accuracy spot check, citing that only one sentence changed, and mentions the full review as the alternative
Does not invoke deephaven-core-accuracy-spot-check, deephaven-docs-review-full, or any other review skill before the person has chosen
Does not ask for a target, since the request already names the page

evals.prompt: Do a full review of docs/python/conceptual/table-types.md.
evals.expected_output: Does not use the router; goes straight to the full review because the depth is stated.
expectations: Invokes deephaven-docs-review-full directly
Does not present a pick list or ask which kind of review is wanted

evals.prompt: help me write docs for this
evals.expected_output: Asks what is being documented (or reads the working-tree diff to find out) before asking about the reader, and does not draft anything.
expectations: Checks the working tree or asks what feature, API, or workflow is being documented
Asks at most one question in the message
Does not write any documentation yet

evals.prompt: I added a new Table method, `tail_pct_by`, and I need docs for it. Where do they go and what should I write?
evals.expected_output: Concludes that a reference entry is needed plus possibly a how-to, using the categories reference, checks for existing coverage, and presents a short plan before writing.
expectations: Identifies a reference guide entry as the primary doc and optionally a how-to for the workflow, using ref-deephaven-doc-categories rather than a made-up taxonomy
Says which directory the pages belong in and notes the Python and Groovy pair and sidebar updates
Searches docs/ for existing coverage before proposing a new page
Asks the person to confirm the plan before writing anything

evals.prompt: I want a step-by-step walkthrough teaching new users about ticking tables. Is that a tutorial?
evals.expected_output: Explains that in this repo only the Crash Course is a tutorial; a walkthrough where the reader brings their own data is a how-to guide, and a why/how explanation is a concept guide.
expectations: States that the Crash Course is the only tutorial among the four categories
Steers the person to a how-to guide or a concept guide depending on whether the reader is doing a task or building understanding
Does not call a new standalone page a tutorial

evals.prompt: Copilot left 6 comments on my docs PR, can you go through them?
evals.expected_output: Does not use the router; uses deephaven-docs-address-review-comments.
expectations: Invokes deephaven-docs-address-review-comments directly
Does not offer the review pick list
